_comment: Named-trait registry for the recipe->derivation model. Traits here GATE and MARK a component (which damage channels and interactions apply); they never add or multiply a stat value, so a stat keeps exactly one source (matter, form, or function). Derived flags mark a component when a material property crosses a threshold declared in propertyTraitMapping.json; corrosive is granted by an organ. Conditions are transient, stored per instance in world state, and drain matter over time.

flammable.description: Derived on read when the composition's blended flammability crosses the propertyTraitMapping threshold; the component can catch fire and be consumed by the heat channel.

conductive.description: Derived on read when the composition's blended electrical conduction crosses the propertyTraitMapping threshold; the component channels the electricity damage.

corrosive.description: Granted by a specific internal component (organ); the component leaks corrosive matter that degrades other components through the corrosion channel.

burning.description: Transient: while burning, the component loses matter to the heat channel each tick until it ceases to exist.

wet.description: Transient: the component holds moisture, changing how the heat and electricity channels interact with it (a wet conductor shorts; wet wood insulates less).

corroded.description: Transient: the component loses matter to the corrosion channel each tick with no attacker at all.
